messages:

sam: WHAT???? HUGE congrats on both!! Oct 2 count me in.

al: bringing a portable speaker and some fairy lights. need a cake?

jules: love it all. leaning charcuterie + cupcakes. partners welcome. thanks everyone 94 overwhelmed in the best way :)
